Titles.jpn: 高校武闘伝 クローズ

Summaries.eng: Harumichi Bouya is the new transfer student coming to Suzuran High School, nicknamed the "School of Crows" because of the jet-black school outfit & the fact that all of the students are hated delinquents.  Harumichi quickly becomes friends with Yasuo Yasuda, a small & weak boy who is easily preyed upon by the large Akutsu.  Though Harumichi has no interest in the existing gang wars in Suzuran to determine who can lead the school as a unified group, a feat that has never been done in the history of the school, he still gets involved when his beastly power in fighting attracts the attention of Hideto Bandou, who leads a division of a motorcycle gang called The Front of Armament.
Summaries.jpn: 春道坊主は鈴蘭高校に転校した新入生で、真っ黒な学校の装いと全員が滞納者を嫌うことから「カラスの学校」と呼ばれています。 ハルミチは、大きなアクツに簡単に捕食される小さくて弱い男の子、安田康夫とすぐに友達になります。 春道は鈴蘭での既存のギャング戦争に誰が団結したグループとして学校を率いることができるかを決めることに興味がないが、学校の歴史では決して行われなかった偉業であるが、彼の戦いにおける彼の獣の力が引き付けられるとき、彼はまだ関与している The FrontofArmamentと呼ばれるオートバイギャングの一部門を率いるBandouHidetoの注目。

Summaries.eng: Harumichi Bouya is the new transfer student coming to Suzuran High School, nicknamed the "School of Crows" because of the jet-black school outfit & the fact that all of the students are hated delinquents.  Harumichi quickly becomes friends with Yasuo Yasuda, a small & weak boy who is easily preyed upon by the large Akutsu.  Though Harumichi has no interest in the existing gang wars in Suzuran to determine who can lead the school as a unified group, a feat that has never been done in the history of the school, he still gets involved when his beastly power in fighting attracts the attention of Hideto Bandou, who leads a division of a motorcycle gang called The Front of Armament.

In this episode we're introduced to Megumi Hayashida, better known as Rindaman, the all-out toughest student in Suzuran (though he only gets into fights when provoked; he doesn't care about ruling the school).  The mystery behind him goes as far as people saying that he's a murderer, having killed his father & brother (which isn't true, but isn't false, either), which helps catch Harumichi's interest, making him want to fight the giant.
